title: NUTRI FIT Digital Food Scale Kitchen 0.1oz Ultra Slim, Coffee Scale, Weighing for Ounces and Grams Accurate for Weight Loss, Baking, Dieting, Keto Cooking, Meal Prep, Black
description:
About this item
Weigh up to 5kg/11lbs in increment to 0.1oz /1g for the Kitchen Food Scale. The Digital food scale is designed and crafted with quality in mind using the highest precision sensors to ensure accurate instant weight readings every single time.
Large weighing panel allows you to read result even with large container. The baking scale is equipped with 4 units of measure; easily convert between grams,ounces, milliliters, kilograms, pounds and ounces (lb:oz, g, ml, fl:oz)
Stylish Hanging Design: The sleek design allows you to accent your home kitchen with a modern fashion touch and amazing sight, or effortlessly hang the scale stow as a decoration, Its slim design also makes it easy to store in any cabinet while saving space for the rest of your kitchen essentials.
Multi- Function: features a clear LCD display, low power, overload indication and auto-off function after 3 minute of inactivity make weighing your foods Hassle-Free. It will help to save the power while you are not going to use it.
Package Included 1 x digital kitchen scale, 1 x CR2032 cell coin battery, 1 x user manual and lifetime support.

reviews_5s:
I love this cute little scale. I've never had a food scale before. When I got a bread machine, I found out what a difference it makes to weigh out ingredients. Using measuring cups and spoons are very inaccurate. I wanted a scale with a replaceable battery, because I always seem to lose cords, and it seems like it's more convenient to not have to recharge it. Very few scales were battery powered, so that made this one stand out. It uses a CR2025, which is easy to find for a couple bucks. The scale is easy to set and easy to read. The battery should last a really long time, since it automatically shuts off. And unless you're a power baker, which I am not, you might only use it for two minutes at a time. When using it, I put a piece of cellophane over it to keep it clean. It seems it would be easy to wipe off if needed. I wasn't sure how to store it at first. I considered putting it in a kitchen drawer in its box. It seems a little fragile, so I was worried that someone would be too rough with it or put something too heavy on it. I finally decided to store it in the bookcase with my cookbooks. It fits right in perfectly. It's so slim, nobody will probably even notice it, and it stays clean and ready for whenever I want to use it.So far, so good. I like it, because unlike the one I had before I can turn it off with the press of a button, and it has many types of measuring units which means I don't have to try figure it out online, makes it easy to read.

It's big enough for what we need it, and it's easy to use and to clean.

It comes with the battery.

It doesn't feel very sturdy, but this is not something I have good parameters on, as I've had it less than a month. If something changes, I'll update the review.I love this kitchen scale! I use it often for making sourdough bread and feeding my starter. It has been very durable so far and very easy to use. It is thin and lightweight and looks very aesthetically pleasing. It is high-quality and I have had no issues with the battery life. it was very inexpensive and makes my life so much easier.It came quickly.
